natural: A thousand autumns and ten thousand generations

meaning.en: For all generations to come; forever.
meaning.zh: 千年万代，形容岁月长久。

examples.zh: 保护环境是造福千秋万代的事业。
examples.en: Protecting the environment benefits generations to come.

examples.zh: 他们的功绩将千秋万代被人铭记。
examples.en: Their achievements will be remembered for ever.

natural: The time comes and luck turns

meaning.en: One's luck turns for the better.
meaning.zh: 时机来了，命运有了转机。指境况好转。

examples.zh: 他穷了半辈子，最近终于时来运转。
examples.en: Poor for half his life, his luck has finally turned.

examples.zh: 别灰心，总有时来运转的一天。
examples.en: Don't lose heart — your ship will come in one day.

natural: All forms and colours

meaning.en: All kinds of; of every description.
meaning.zh: 形容事物种类繁多，各式各样。

examples.zh: 在大城市里，你会遇到形形色色的人。
examples.en: In a big city you meet all sorts of people.

examples.zh: 商场里有形形色色的商品。
examples.en: The mall has goods of every description.

natural: Tempered a hundred times into steel

meaning.en: Hardened by long trials; forged in adversity.
meaning.zh: 比喻久经锻炼，变得非常坚强。

equivalents: what doesn't kill you makes you stronger

examples.zh: 经过多年磨炼，他百炼成钢。
examples.en: Years of hardship have forged him into steel.

examples.zh: 这支队伍在艰苦环境中百炼成钢。
examples.en: The team was battle-hardened by tough conditions.

natural: Reviewing the old to understand the new

meaning.en: To gain new insights by reviewing what one has learned.
meaning.zh: 温习旧的知识，能得到新的理解和体会。

examples.zh: 复习时温故知新，往往会有新的收获。
examples.en: Reviewing old material often brings new insights.

examples.zh: 读历史可以温故知新。
examples.en: Reading history lets us learn from the past.

story.en: Confucius: "One who reviews the old and comes to know the new may be a teacher" (温故而知新，可以为师矣).
story.zh: 《论语·为政》："温故而知新，可以为师矣。"

natural: Every word a pearl

meaning.en: Every word a gem; beautifully written.
meaning.zh: 每个字都像珠宝一样。比喻文章写得精彩。

examples.zh: 这篇散文字字珠玑。
examples.en: Every word of this essay is a gem.

examples.zh: 老师的评语字字珠玑。
examples.en: The teacher's comments were pearls of wisdom.

natural: Red flowers and green willows

meaning.en: A bright spring scene of red flowers and green willows.
meaning.zh: 形容明媚的春天景象，也形容颜色鲜艳纷繁。

examples.zh: 春天的公园花红柳绿。
examples.en: In spring the park is a riot of red flowers and green willows.

examples.zh: 孩子们穿得花红柳绿的。
examples.en: The children were dressed in bright colours.

natural: A cunning hare has three burrows

meaning.en: To have several escape routes or backup plans.
meaning.zh: 狡猾的兔子有三个洞。比喻藏身的地方多，或避祸的计划周密。

equivalents: don't put all your eggs in one basket

examples.zh: 他狡兔三窟，在好几个国家都有房产。
examples.en: He keeps his options open, with property in several countries.

examples.zh: 投资要狡兔三窟，分散风险。
examples.en: In investing, spread your risk — don't put all your eggs in one basket.

story.en: Feng Xuan told Lord Mengchang: "A cunning hare has three burrows and so escapes death; you have only one" — and set about securing two more refuges for him.
story.zh: 冯谖对孟尝君说："狡兔有三窟，仅得免其死耳。今君有一窟，未得高枕而卧也。"

usage.en: Predicate. Can be neutral (prudent) or critical (crafty).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可中性也可贬义。

natural: The wood has already become a boat

meaning.en: What's done is done; a fait accompli.
meaning.zh: 木头已经做成了船。比喻事情已经成为定局，无法改变。

equivalents: no use crying over spilt milk

examples.zh: 木已成舟，后悔也没用了。
examples.en: What's done is done — regret won't help.

examples.zh: 合同已经签了，木已成舟。
examples.en: The contract is signed — it's a fait accompli.

usage.en: Predicate or standalone clause. Often with 生米煮成熟饭.

natural: Disaster falling from the sky

meaning.en: A sudden, unexpected calamity.
meaning.zh: 比喻突然遭到意外的灾祸。

examples.zh: 他好好地走在路上，却被车撞了，真是祸从天降。
examples.en: He was just walking along when a car hit him — a bolt from the blue.

examples.zh: 一场大火让他祸从天降，失去了一切。
examples.en: A fire struck out of nowhere, and he lost everything.

natural: Forced up to Mount Liang

meaning.en: Driven to desperate measures; forced into rebellion.
meaning.zh: 被逼上梁山造反。比喻被迫进行反抗或不得不做某事。

examples.zh: 我本不想辞职，是被逼上梁山的。
examples.en: I didn't want to resign — I was driven to it.

examples.zh: 他不擅长做饭，老婆出差，只好逼上梁山。
examples.en: He's no cook, but with his wife away he had no choice.

story.en: In the Water Margin, honest men like the drill instructor Lin Chong are persecuted by corrupt officials until they have no choice but to join the outlaws on Mount Liang.
story.zh: 《水浒传》中林冲等人遭奸臣陷害，走投无路，被迫上梁山落草。

usage.zh: 多作谓语，现常诙谐使用。

natural: Small minds troubling themselves

meaning.en: To worry needlessly; to create problems for oneself.
meaning.zh: 平庸的人没事找事，自寻烦恼。

equivalents: make a mountain out of a molehill

examples.zh: 事情没那么严重，你别庸人自扰。
examples.en: It's not that serious — don't worry over nothing.

examples.zh: 天下本无事，庸人自扰之。
examples.en: The world is calm; it's small minds that stir up trouble.

story.en: The minister Lu Xiangxian said: "The world has no trouble in itself; it's small-minded people who stir it up" (天下本无事，庸人扰之为烦耳).
story.zh: 陆象先说："天下本无事，庸人扰之为烦耳。"

natural: A belly full of statecraft

meaning.en: Highly learned and capable.
meaning.zh: 比喻人很有学问和才干。

examples.zh: 这位老先生满腹经纶。
examples.en: The old gentleman is deeply learned.

examples.zh: 他满腹经纶，却不善表达。
examples.en: He's erudite but not good at expressing himself.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 经纶 = threads of silk, i.e. ability to govern.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"经纶"指治理国家的才能。

natural: Empty and hollow, with nothing inside

meaning.en: Empty and devoid of substance.
meaning.zh: 空空洞洞，没有什么内容。多指言论、文章。

examples.zh: 这篇演讲空洞无物。
examples.en: The speech was devoid of substance.

examples.zh: 写作文要言之有物，不能空洞无物。
examples.en: An essay needs substance, not waffle.

natural: Grand ambitions not yet fulfilled

meaning.en: Lofty ambitions left unfulfilled.
meaning.zh: 宏大的志愿没有实现。

examples.zh: 他壮志未酬，就病倒了。
examples.en: He fell ill with his great ambitions still unfulfilled.

examples.zh: 诸葛亮壮志未酬身先死。
examples.en: Zhuge Liang died before his great ambition was achieved.

natural: The work fails on the verge of completion

meaning.en: To fail on the verge of success.
meaning.zh: 事情在即将成功的时候遭到失败。

equivalents: snatch defeat from the jaws of victory

examples.zh: 最后一刻出现失误，功败垂成。
examples.en: A mistake at the last moment meant failure on the verge of success.

examples.zh: 这次实验功败垂成，太可惜了。
examples.en: The experiment failed just short of success — such a shame.

natural: Pulling down the bridge after crossing the river

meaning.en: To abandon those who helped you once you no longer need them.
meaning.zh: 自己过了河，便把桥拆掉。比喻达到目的后，就把帮助过自己的人一脚踢开。

equivalents: bite the hand that fed you

examples.zh: 他升职后就过河拆桥，不理老朋友了。
examples.en: After his promotion he kicked away the ladder and ignored his old friends.

examples.zh: 做人不能过河拆桥。
examples.en: Never drop people once they've served their purpose.

natural: Those on the right path get much help

meaning.en: A just cause wins wide support.
meaning.zh: 站在正义方面，就能得到多数人的支持和帮助。

examples.zh: 得道多助，失道寡助。
examples.en: A just cause wins wide support; an unjust one finds few friends.

examples.zh: 这家企业诚信经营，得道多助。
examples.en: The company does business honestly and has won wide support.

story.en: Mencius: "Those who have the Way find many to help them; those who lose the Way find few" (得道者多助，失道者寡助).
story.zh: 《孟子》："得道者多助，失道者寡助。"

natural: Wildly arrogant and self-important

meaning.en: Wildly arrogant.
meaning.zh: 极其放肆地自以为了不起。

examples.zh: 他狂妄自大，听不进任何批评。
examples.en: He's so arrogant he won't hear any criticism.

examples.zh: 狂妄自大的人迟早会碰壁。
examples.en: Arrogant people will hit a wall sooner or later.

natural: Seams splitting in a hundred places

meaning.en: Full of holes; riddled with flaws.
meaning.zh: 说话做事漏洞很多。

examples.zh: 他的谎言破绽百出。
examples.en: His lie is full of holes.

examples.zh: 这份报告数据破绽百出。
examples.en: The report's figures are riddled with flaws.

natural: Having lived through seas turning into mulberry fields

meaning.en: To have lived through great changes and hardships.
meaning.zh: 经历了多次世事变迁。

examples.zh: 这位老人历尽沧桑，看淡了一切。
examples.en: The old man has weathered many storms and takes everything in his stride.

examples.zh: 这座古城历尽沧桑，依然屹立。
examples.en: The ancient city has seen great changes and still stands.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 沧桑 from 沧海桑田 (seas becoming mulberry fields).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"沧桑"出自"沧海桑田"。

natural: Nine sure out of ten

meaning.en: Almost certain; a safe bet.
meaning.zh: 比喻很有把握。

examples.zh: 这次考试他十拿九稳能过。
examples.en: He's a safe bet to pass this exam.

examples.zh: 这个项目十拿九稳，你放心吧。
examples.en: This project is as good as done — don't worry.

natural: Letting an abscess grow and leaving trouble

meaning.en: Neglecting a problem until it becomes a disaster.
meaning.zh: 长了毒疮不去医治，就会留下后患。比喻姑息坏人坏事，结果遭受祸害。

equivalents: a stitch in time saves nine (negated)

examples.zh: 对腐败现象不能养痈遗患。
examples.en: Corruption mustn't be left to fester.

examples.zh: 小问题不及时解决，就会养痈遗患。
examples.en: Small problems left unsolved store up trouble.

story.en: Feng Yan warned that tolerating evil is "nourishing an abscess and growing a boil, bringing calamity on oneself" (养痈长疽，自生祸殃).
story.zh: 《后汉书·冯衍传》："养痈长疽，自生祸殃。"

natural: Roaming to the ends of the earth

meaning.en: To roam the world; to wander far and wide.
meaning.zh: 到处漂泊，行踪不定。

examples.zh: 他年轻时浪迹天涯，去过几十个国家。
examples.en: In his youth he roamed the world, visiting dozens of countries.

examples.zh: 她背着吉他浪迹天涯。
examples.en: She wandered far and wide with her guitar on her back.

natural: Hanging cliffs and steep walls of rock

meaning.en: Sheer cliffs and precipices.
meaning.zh: 形容山势险峻。

examples.zh: 山路两边都是悬崖峭壁。
examples.en: The mountain road is lined with sheer cliffs on both sides.

examples.zh: 攀岩者在悬崖峭壁上攀爬。
examples.en: Climbers scale the sheer rock face.

usage.en: Noun phrase; subject or object. A descriptive 四字词语.
